questions.question: When was the first iPhone released?
questions.answer: 2007 - The original iPhone launched in June 2007 and revolutionized the smartphone industry.

questions.question: As of 2023, what percentage of the world population owns a smartphone?
questions.answer: 68% - That's more than two-thirds of the global population, showing how fast smartphone access has spread in just over a decade.

questions.question: Which country has the highest average daily smartphone usage time per person?
How many times does the average user check their phone per day?
What is the average screen time per day for smartphone users worldwide?
questions.answer: 4.9 hours - On average, users spend nearly 5 hours per day on their phones, often split between social media, messaging, and entertainment.

questions.question: What percentage of smartphone users have tried to reduce their screen time in the past year?
Which app category takes up the most screen time globally?
Which company sold the most smartphones in 2023?
questions.answer: Samsung - Despite fierce competition, Samsung continues to lead global shipments thanks to its wide range of devices.
